Why UTRGV?
Choosing the right university is a big decision, and The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV) is here to help you make the best choice for your future. As one of the top-ranked universities in Texas, UTRGV offers exceptional academic programs, affordable tuition, and a supportive campus community committed to your success.
Whether you’re looking for innovative research opportunities, a vibrant student life, or a university that feels like home, UTRGV has it all. Make UTRGV your first choice and take the next step toward a bright future!

Medical Professions
UTRGV's School of Medicine and School of Podiatric Medicine are dedicated to shaping the future of healthcare through innovation, research, and compassionate patient care.
The School of Medicine provides world-class medical education, fostering the next generation of physicians focusing on serving underserved communities. Meanwhile, the School of Podiatric Medicine, the first in Texas, offers specialized foot and ankle care training, preparing students to address critical needs in podiatric healthcare. Both schools emphasize hands-on learning, community involvement, and a commitment to improving health outcomes across the Rio Grande Valley and beyond.
